definitions.name: R1A.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value, element-wise over a Vector

definitions.name: R1A.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V X1.FIROSO SUB R1A.ABS X1.FIROSO
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: R1A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD V 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers

definitions.name: R1A.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: R1A.MODE
definitions.note: most frequent number, smallest on ties

definitions.name: R1A.TRIMMED
definitions.note: mean after dropping one smallest and one largest

definitions.name: R1A.ARGMAX-BY-LEN
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP X1.PIMAPA GET
definitions.note: longest String in a Vector, first on ties

definitions.name: R1A.CAPWORD
definitions.body: CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: a word with its first letter upper-cased

definitions.name: R1A.INITIALS
definitions.body: X1.VIDIKO [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: upper-case initials of the words longer than three letters in a text

definitions.name: R1A.DEBTORS
definitions.body: X1.RIVINO 'R' BIND R KEYS [ 'K' BIND R K GET 0 LT ] FILTER
definitions.note: names whose ledger amounts sum below zero, in first-appearance order

definitions.name: R1A.LARGEST-ENTRY
definitions.body: 'E' BIND E E [ 1 GET ] MAP X1.PIMAPA GET
definitions.note: ledger entry with the largest single amount, first on ties
